inspiration.observed_pattern: A migration uses a LEFT JOIN during an UPDATE to normalize textual MAC addresses with UNHEX(REPLACE(...)) and textual IPv4 or IPv6 addresses with INET6_ATON while copying a nullable category key.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored network-interface inventory update. Existing text columns are converted into binary MAC and IP projections, a LEFT JOIN maps known interface classes, and NULL/unknown class rows verify null preservation. The schema, rows, names, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Interface 101 uses an IPv4 address and known wired class; 102 uses an IPv6 address and known wireless class; 103 has an unknown class that must retain a NULL class code; 104 has a NULL address that must produce a NULL binary IP while still receiving its known class code.
determinism_notes: Interface IDs, addresses, MAC strings, and class mappings are fixed; the final projection is ordered by the unique interface ID with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE interface_classes (class_code INT PRIMARY KEY, class_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE interface_inventory (interface_id INT PRIMARY KEY, address_text VARCHAR(42) NULL, mac_text VARCHAR(17) NOT NULL, class_name VARCHAR(16) NULL, mac_bytes VARBINARY(6) NULL, ip_bytes VARBINARY(16) NULL, class_code INT NULL)

INSERT INTO interface_inventory VALUES (101, '192.0.2.17', '02:00:5E:10:00:01', 'wired', NULL, NULL, NULL), (102, '2001:db8::42', '02:00:5E:10:00:02', 'wireless', NULL, NULL, NULL), (103, '2001:db8::99', '02:00:5E:10:00:03', 'satellite', NULL, NULL, NULL), (104, NULL, '02:00:5E:10:00:04', 'wired', NULL, NULL, NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE interface_inventory i LEFT JOIN interface_classes c ON c.class_name = i.class_name SET i.mac_bytes = UNHEX(REPLACE(i.mac_text, ':', '')), i.ip_bytes = INET6_ATON(i.address_text), i.class_code = c.class_code
SELECT interface_id, HEX(mac_bytes) AS mac_hex, HEX(ip_bytes) AS ip_hex, class_code FROM interface_inventory ORDER BY interface_id
